overview: This Senate resolution names the week of September 21, 2026, as "Ray Gaesser Memorial Farm Safety Week." Ray Gaesser was an Iowa farmer and former president of the Iowa Soybean Association and the American Soybean Association who died in a farming accident. The resolution notes that federal health officials consider agriculture one of the most dangerous industries, with many farm workers injured every day. It honors his life and leadership, recognizes the sacrifices of farm families, and stresses the need for education to prevent farm accidents. It does not create a program or spend money. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on September 28, 2026.
for: Supporters say tying farm safety awareness to a respected farmer's memory can draw attention to the real dangers of agricultural work and encourage safer practices.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not fund farm safety training or change any safety rules.
